editorial_review.character_consistency: Hazel and the hero Stonekin (smile crack, yellow lichen) are visually distinguishable from crowd Stonekin in SC8-11.
editorial_review.story_originality: Musical-statues mechanic with a living boulder; conflict and twist are unique in the slate.
editorial_review.scene_continuity: Time of day progresses afternoon -> dusk -> pre-dawn -> sunrise; tin mug introduced SC2 and returns SC11.
editorial_review.visual_quality: Signature frames - mid-air freeze (SC4), upside-down POV (SC6), row of boulders (SC8), sunrise (SC10).
editorial_review.animation_feasibility: Stonekin are simple spheres with eyes; the crowd is duplicated with only lichen and size changes.
editorial_review.pacing: Gag escalation every 4-5s; emotional turn at 34s; twist in last 4.5s.
editorial_review.sound_sync: Music stops synced to every turnaround (SC2, SC4, SC6, SC7); stone hum lands with the light sweep.
editorial_review.strong_opening: A boulder rolling uphill in frame 1.
editorial_review.memorable_ending: The game reverses - the boulder peeks at Hazel.
